svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
JOIN THE HULL: ONE COLLAR, KEEL, RING FRAMES
The cargo/middle collar joins the two sections
Bond the keel segments into the forward (cargo) and aft (rear) keel runs.
Bond the two ring frames into their keel notches.
Bond the collar into both sections; clamp and cure.
Keel splice and frame stations are still in the R1 datum and predate the one-piece aft section; re-derive them in R2 before
